visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The opening shot features a close-up profile of a Shiba Inu against a pitch-black background. Side lighting dramatically highlights its fur texture and snout. A stylized yellow and white title logo is visible in the top left corner. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor living room with tiled floors. A man in a white t-shirt and the Shiba Inu are sitting on the floor. The man is focused on playing Jenga with wooden blocks, while the dog watches intently. (3) The man removes a block, and the tower suddenly collapses. The man reacts with surprise, and the dog jumps up playfully, interacting with the fallen wooden pieces on the floor. (4) The setting shifts to a lush green rice field under bright daylight. A man in an egg-shaped costume stands in the middle of the field, gesturing with both hands. A rice cooker lid opens to reveal perfectly cooked, steaming white grains inside a black pot. (5) Back indoors at a dining table, the dog is seated at the head of the table surrounded by various dishes. A man and a woman are seated on either side, eating and interacting with the dog. (6) A glass bottle is shown being poured into a clear square tumbler, with golden liquid splashing inside. The man is then shown in a wine cellar environment with large wooden barrels in the background, holding a glass. (7) All the promotional products, including the Jenga box, rice package, and brandy bottle, are arranged neatly on a table. The man sits with the dog and pets it affectionately as decorative text and logos overlay the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a rhythmic, high-energy BGM featuring a strong drum beat. A high-pitched dog bark triggers a friendly, fast-paced male voice-over that introduces the gift box. (2) A sharp 'click' and 'clack' SFX of wooden blocks is heard, followed by a comedic 'slide whistle' sound effect. As the Jenga tower falls, a loud, multi-frequency percussive thud occurs, accompanied by the sound of numerous wooden pieces scattering. (3) The audio transitions with a 'whoosh' into a whimsical acoustic track with flute melodies. Sounds of a rice cooker hissing and a lid opening with a metallic 'clink' are heard. The narrator's tone remains cheerful and informative. (4) A distinct 'glug-glug' liquid pouring sound effect is featured as the brandy is shown. This is followed by the high-frequency 'clink' of glasses touching. The BGM shifts to a sophisticated, jazzy piano-driven style. (5) The narrator delivers a concluding summary with an warm, upbeat vocal tone as the music swells in volume. A soft 'thud' and ruffling sound suggest petting the dog, ending with a final bright 'ding' SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional advertisement for the 'Golden Horse 62' limited edition gift box in Taichung. It utilizes a popular pet influencer (Shiba Inu Nana) and its owner to showcase three distinct items: wooden Jenga, premium rice, and brandy, emphasizing themes of family gathering and celebration.
